reviews.title: A familiar favorite with a much quieter click
reviews.comment: I picked up this Logitech trackball to pair with a new Windows machine, and it has integrated into my workflow perfectly. Having used the previous version for over five years, I already knew the ergonomics were top-tier, but the improvements here are immediately noticeable. The most significant change is how quiet the clicks are—they are almost completely silent, which is a great touch for a focused workspace. What makes this a powerhouse for my desk is the connectivity. I switch between systems seamlessly by pairing via Bluetooth to my Mac and using the 2.4GHz dongle for my PC. I’ve even moved my older trackball over to my iPad; using it with the newer "desktop-style" iPadOS layout makes the tablet much more user-friendly and precise. This is a highly reliable tool that stays comfortable through long hours of use. It is definitely worth the price of admission, especially if you can catch it on sale. Whether you are upgrading from an older model or starting fresh, it’s a fantastic investment.
reviews.author: Tim Brown

reviews.comment: I’m am always pleased with Logitech products, and this mouse is no difference. It’s compatible with my laptop and my iPad.
